description: ⚠️⚠️ orders drop off the company merge list: the losing company's orders stay behind with nobody to bill, which is what actually happened
⚠️⚠️ campaign_log drops off the contact merge list: it cascades, so merging two contacts deletes the losing one's entire send, open and click history in silence
the appointment attendee keeps pointing at the contact that was deleted: the invitee on a past meeting stops being anybody
the lead's tickets are left behind by the merge: the support history of the person who was merged away is no longer theirs
